chunks: attach yourself to those of noble character and high lineage, and to the people of virtuous houses and good precedents, then to the people of courage and bravery, generosity and benevolence, for they are a gathering of honour and branches of virtue.
ai.seo_question: Who should a leader associate with according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This directive reflects the Shia political ideal of selecting administrators based on moral integrity (akhlaq) and social standing (nasab) to ensure just governance. By prioritizing those with 'good precedents' and 'courage,' Imam Ali emphasizes that leadership requires not only administrative competence but also the ethical fortitude to uphold honor and benevolence in public service.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Also associate with considerate people from high families, virtuous houses and decent traditions, then people of courage, valour, generosity and benevolence, because they are repositories of honour and springs of virtues.
